# Good Housekeeping

> Good Housekeeping is a Hearst brand whose product recommendations are backed by hands-on testing from the Good Housekeeping Institute, and whose Good Housekeeping Seal signals independently verified quality.

Key notes for interpreting this file:

- Pages marked "Tested" or "Lab Testing" in their titles reflect hands-on Good Housekeeping Institute evaluation.
- goodhousekeeping.com does not serve a Markdown ("`.md`") twin of its pages. Every link below points to the standard canonical HTML URL; there is no `.md`-suffixed alternative to request.
- This is a curated index of high-value content, not a full sitemap. See https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/sitemap_index.xml for all URLs.

## About

- [Customer Service](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/_assets/seo/static/llms/llms-ghk/customer-service.md): Visit the customer service portal to get help with your subscription or find out how to contact us with questions.

## About Institute

## Appliances

Our top picks work on carpets, hardwood, pet hair, and more.

Our engineers tested and reviewed AC units to find the best picks whether you are looking to cool a large or small room.
